SYSTEMEU - Financial Support to Third Parties (FSTP) 

What is the aim?
To support digital innovations in healthcare, energy and mobility as they progress from the prototype stage (TRL 6) to a market-ready system (TRL 8).

Who can take part?
Regions: Bavaria (DE), Norte Region (PT), Castile and León (ES), Romania (RO) and Tuzla (BiH) only.
Consortia: 2–8 partners from at least 2–5 regions (depending on project size).

Type: Triple Helix (academia, business, public authorities).

Project sizes & budget

Flagship: up to €2.2 million (5–8 partners, all regions). Proposed by consortia composed by 5 to 8 partners covering all 5 participating SYSTEMEU regions and including at least one RTO/University, one company, and one public sector entity actively involved in public service delivery (e.g., municipal administrations or hospitals).
